verdict.rationale: Loops documents an official CLI on its own page (/agents/cli). The CLI manages contacts, sends events, triggers transactional emails and tests integrations from the terminal. A one-command install bundles the CLI with agent skills for coding agents, and there is a dedicated CLI skill. Missing for 10: detailed CLI command reference or install docs in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI works as described.
